notes.title: Last Train Home - Update 3.0 - Patch notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237776/4157c994882f1e6281ef22d9db85cf087ebc8fe3.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings, Legionaries! [/h3]

We're excited to inform you about the third update for Last Train Home. This patch includes many bug fixes and balancing based on your valuable feedback. We sincerely appreciate your time and effort in reporting bugs and sharing your opinions about the game! Enjoy the update! 

[h2]Update 3.0 - Patch Notes[/h2] 

[h3]Major fixes [/h3]
- Problems happening after [b]save/load:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Empty vehicles are no longer suddenly becoming hostile. 
[*] Squad info refreshes correctly.  
[*] Coal for heating is consumed only when it should be. 
[*] The train can properly leave the station it has already visited. 
[/list]
- Text Event following the end of [b]Chany mission[/b] and [b]Drunk Driver[/b] Text Event do not block progress in the game.  
- Sudden [b]item duplication[/b] in train management is no longer happening.
- Machine gunners' [b]Suppressive Fire skill [/b]works properly. 
- Healing and the Stabilize skill used on a [b]downed soldier[/b] work properly.  
- It is better communicated that the [b]Stealth Kill[/b] can’t be used in close succession. 
- [b]Rifle Ammo Bag[/b] research now applies not only to Riflemen, but also to Scouts and Grenadiers. 
- [b]Tanks[/b] are able to hit even if the target is fairly close. 
- The [b]explosive barrels [/b]no longer explode after they have been already destroyed. 


[h3]Additions and improvements[/h3]
 - Improvements in the [b]Edit Squad Screen [/b]to achieve better communication of relevant Soldier Traits 
[list]
[*] Added: Beneficial Traits Filter that provides an idea of who you should select for the deployment.  
[*] Enabled: Point of Interest screen element is visible in Edit Squad Screen for better overview. 
[*] Added: Highlight of soldiers when hovering over Beneficial Traits. 
[/list]
- Added: [b]Attack Ground command[/b], thanks to which is now possible to target ground with artillery vehicles. 

[h3]Mission-related fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Vladivostok[/b]: The issue of disappearing ammo for soldiers in trucks after loading the game is fixed. Soldiers can reload properly from the shared stash. 
[*] [b]Sukhinichi[/b]: Sudden mission failure following killing a civilian is no longer happening. 
[*] [b]Canyon[/b]: All the new soldiers get rescued correctly no matter which exit area is used. 
[*] [b]Barabinsk[/b]: Bridge explosions at the beginning moved and timed in a way that player- controlled units shouldn’t be harmed by them. 
[*] [b]Pisky[/b]: ‘Patchwork Makes Dream Work’ challenge now works properly. 
[/list]
[b][i]Note: While mission-specific issues were fixed, we recommend that you replay such missions from the beginning and do not load a previously created in-mission save where you experienced the problem.[/i][/b] 

[h3]Balancing changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Balancing of the [b]frequency and timing of punishing events[/b] in train management. There should be fewer harsh events happening in a short period of time and in starting segments. 
[*] Balancing of [b]Traits impact[/b] (Herbalist, Hunter) on resource gathering in Points of Interest (lakes, forests, villages). 
[*] Balancing of [b]Operational Damage[/b] on train cars and respective [b]Endurance upgrades[/b] (Improved Leaf Springs, Metal Plating, Advanced Framing). Train cars now receive damage from a traveled distance, and it should feel more beneficial to make Endurance upgrades. 
[*] Balancing of [b]metal costs [/b]on car upgrades, fixing car statuses, research and crafting recipes. 
[*] Balancing done to make [b]ammo crafting[/b] less expensive. 
[/list]
[h3]DLC-specific fixes and improvements (spoilers included)[/h3]
- [b]Narrative squads[/b] balancing and tweaks: 
[list]
[*] All narrative squads now should have at least two soldiers with Stabilize or Heal skills and should feel stronger while playing the missions.  
[*] Profession levels were increased together with attributes to improve soldiers’ health, weapon handling, range of throwable skills (e. g. throwing a grenade). 
[/list]
- [b]Our Efforts/The Baikal Story:[/b]
[list]
[*] The ‘Massacre’ challenge can be finished as intended. 
[*] The armored car can no longer be entered to avoid unexpected explosions. 
[*] The playable area no longer locks back after getting to the pier. 
[*] Added: Covers in important locations.
[/list]  
[b]- Czech Revolutionary/The Incident Story:[/b]  
[list]
[*] The mission is finishable even without completing ‘Save the civilian’ challenge.  
[*] ‘Smooth and cool’ challenge now works properly. 
[/list] 
[b]- Our Company/The Blockade Story: [/b] 
[list]
[*] The challenge to eliminate all enemies now works properly. 
[/list]
[b]- The Swings/The Long Story: [/b]
[list]
[*] Soldiers and tanks no longer disappear at the edge of the map; making it possible to leave the mission properly. 
[/list]
[b]- Barlie/The Cat Story: [/b]
[list]
[*] The falling rocks no longer block the way out. 
[/list]
[b]- Maxim/The Machine gunner Story: [/b]
[list]
[*] The time pressure challenge works correctly now. 
[/list]
[b]- The Whip/The Cheka Story: [/b]
[list]
[*] The ‘Brutes’ challenge works properly for all enemy units.  
[/list]

[h3]Other fixes and polishes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Problems to reach Points of Interest were fixed by adjusting waypoints. 
[*] Researched winter uniforms are showing properly in missions. 
[*] Howitzer now starts rotating to the new target immediately instead of finishing rotating to the first target. 
[*] Soldiers should no longer talk about themselves in third person in Text Events (blockades, gathering in Points of Interest). 
[*] Soldiers showed as reward in Text Events, should correspond to the soldiers the player has on board the train. 
[*] Numerous other fixes and polishes for performance, stability, gameplay, and audiovisuals. 
[/list]

We'd also like to remind you of the recently added startup option on Steam: [b]'Play with DLSS Safe Mode for older graphics cards’[/b], which may help players with problems with launching the game. On top of that, we will bring you a [url=https://thqn.net/3wIiPB0]separate article[/url] explaining the [b]consequences of using new Mission Modifiers[/b] that can be used to make enemy behavior more aggressive.  

Enjoy the update!

notes.title: A fix for troubles with launching Last Train Home
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237776/ca0e677efd0da68c5ce834e26a09e56a3880a7aa.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings Legionaries, [/h3]

We're reaching out to share a potential solution for the challenges some of you have encountered when [b]launching Last Train Home[/b]. We're pleased to announce that on [b]Steam[/b], you now have the option to start the game using [b]'Play with DLSS Safe Mode for older graphics cards.'[/b]

This option enables you to run the game with the command parameter '-ngxdisable,' effectively disabling the [b]Nvidia DLSS plugin[/b]. This adjustment addresses startup issues that may arise with certain combinations of graphics cards and drivers. 

We hope that this solution can address the difficulties some of you may have encountered. Please do let us know if it proves effective for you!

[b]Next Stop: Legends! Last Train Home's Legion Tales DLC Expands Historical RTS Today[/b]
 
Brno, Czech Republic / Vienna, Austria, February 1st, 2024: Departure time is now: the critically acclaimed historical RTS, Last Train Home, gets its first DLC, the Legion Tales, today! 

Immerse yourself in 10 legendary missions, each recounting combat encounters that have become the stuff of legends among the legionnaires. Each mission has its own unique story, making every encounter worth retelling. Experience the only naval battle in history Czechoslovak soldiers ever fought. Descend into the depths of a mine for an explosive encounter with your enemies. Or witness a true machine-gun priest mowing down the forces of evil in the name of the Lord. And you can even try to capture a tank and let all hell loose!

Legion Tales Launch Trailer: https://youtu.be/WOLpPvPVgJY

Get Legion Tales here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2617710/

The Legion Tales DLC releases today, February 1st, 2024, with a suggested retail price (SRP) of $14.99 / €14.99 / £11.99. During the first week, until February 8th, the DLC will have a 10% discount. Additionally, the Legion Tales DLC is included in the Last Train Home Deluxe Edition, which will be on sale on Steam from February 1st to February 8th with a substantial 34% discount. This discount also applies to the standard edition of the game.

The perfect time to jump aboard the Last Train Home!

notes.title: Last Train Home – Update 2.0 – Patch notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237776/68f2540603588a66a65db3417f9c45b878e9901b.png[/img]

[h3]Hi, Legionaries![/h3]

We are excited to share that the second update for Last Train Home is now available, featuring numerous fixes inspired by your feedback and bug reports. We deeply appreciate your engagement and diligent reporting of issues in the game, and we are ever grateful that we can improve the gaming experience together. Thank you again for your contributions. Enjoy the update!

[h2]Update 2.0 - Patch Notes[/h2]
[b]Major fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Soldiers now die/desert only once, and multiple soldiers dying/deserting/leveling up at the same time are handled properly
[*] Research/upgrades (such as research for the Kitchen Car and soldier carry capacity) and crafting recipes (such as dismantling Artillery Shell Supplies) are now applied properly
[*] Resource gathering reports (at lakes, villages, etc.), quests (Mysterious Family), missions (Novonikolaevsk, Bajkalovo), and train stops are now properly accessible
[*] Soldier skills (Sprint, Camouflage) and traits (Ghost) now apply their effect correctly
[*] Achievements (Nobody Left Behind, The Real MVP, Druzhina, Historically Accurate, Finally Some Good Fricking Food, Slow and Steady) now trigger correctly  
[/list]
[b]Balancing changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The initial segments of the journey are now less punishing
[*] Soldiers who are downed inside the Exit Area can now be taken back to the train if at least one other soldier from the squad exits correctly
[*] Enemy behavior can now be made more aggressive by adjusting the ranges for Information Sharing, Proximity Awareness, and Loud Noise perception via the Mission Modifiers in the Options Menu
[*] Soldiers now lose silent mode only if they have been directly shot at
[/list]
[b]Guides:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a Train Depot guide with information about all train cars you can obtain
[*] Skill tooltips now mention actions that interrupt the skill (such as move commands interrupting the Medic’s Heal skill) or are forbidden by it (such as Machine Gunners being unable to move while having deployed their Focused Fire skill)
[/list]
[b]Other fixes and polishes:[/b]
Note: while mission-specific issues were fixed, we recommend that you replay such missions from the beginning and do not use in-mission save where you experienced the problem.
[list]
[*] Version number is now available in the Main Menu and Pause Menu
[*] Baikalovo now succeeds after all main objectives have been completed 
[*] Loading a save now handles dead enemies correctly
[*] Numerous other fixes and polishes for performance, stability, gameplay, and audiovisuals
[/list]

Enjoy & stay tuned!

notes.title: Last Train Home - Update 1.0 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Legionaries! [/h3]

We're thrilled to announce that the Last Train Home's[b] first update is live[/b], packed with bug fixes based on your invaluable feedback. Thank you very much for expressing your views on the game and for your diligent issue reporting. We're committed to enhancing your gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237776/1d08b5ed30dcd5ed40cf69af8f0e1ca80839b395.png[/img]

[h1]Update 1.0 - Patch Notes [/h1]
 
Issues that were [u]RESOLVED [/u]with the update: 

[h2]The most important fixes: [/h2]

[list]
[*] Problems connected to [b]auto-assigning soldiers[/b] on the locomotive, including: 
- Soldiers being forced to be [b]left behind[/b] at the end of the chapter. 
- Soldiers [b]changing their combat roles [/b](such as grenadier) [b]to non-combat roles[/b] (such as engineer). 
- [b]Inability to assign[/b] the affected idle soldiers to any task (soldiers were greyed out in the soldiers’ overview). 
[*] Recurring[b] crashes[/b] to the desktop after a few minutes of gameplay related to having [b]SteamVR[/b] on. ([i]Note: The issue is fixed, but we still recommend disconnecting VR headset when playing Last Train Home.[/i]) 
[*] [b]Missing/disappearing User Interface[/b] elements (Edit Squad button, Train Upgrades, etc.)  
[/list]

[h2]Mission-related fixes: [/h2]

[list]
[*] ‘Talk to the villagers’ quest in the [b]Baikalovo mission[/b] that was not triggering correctly. 
[*] Unfinishable quests in the[b] Irkutsk mission[/b] ([i]Note: The issue was fixed, but this mission needs to be replayed if you have experienced issues[/i]). 
[*] ‘Clear the area’ quest in the[b] Novonikolayevsk mission[/b] that was not triggering as expected. ([i]Note: The issue was fixed, but this mission needs to be replayed if you have experienced issues[/i]). 
[/list]

[h2]Soldiers-related fixes:[/h2] 

[list]
[*] [b]Throwing actions [/b](throwing grenades, smoke bombs, etc.) now work properly even when the soldier is outside of the screen.  
[/list]
[h2]
Other tweaks: [/h2]

[list]
[*] The possibility to [b]quit the game without saving [/b]it was added (new buttons in the Pause Menu). 
[*] Another ‘Save Game’ button was added to the Pause Menu (to complement the Quick Save feature). 
[/list]

notes.title: Last Train Home Demo Update - Patch notes
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Legionaries! [/h3]

We're thrilled to announce that the first [b]update [/b]for the [b]Last Train Home Demo[/b] is now [b]live[/b], packed with numerous enhancements and refinements based on your invaluable [b]feedback[/b]. Thank you very much for expressing your views on the game and for your diligent issue reporting. Rest assured, we're committed to [b]further perfecting the gaming experience[/b], and our official release date is just around the corner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237776/96f97844fd0c4c7b949afe4c62ed607056d8889f.png[/img]

[h1]Demo Update – Patch notes [/h1]

[h2]Performance and stability [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed crashes happening: During loading screens;  After clicking ‘Proceed’ in the text event after the Moscow mission; During/after the first mission 
[*] Improved: Performance in the management part of the game 
[*] Optimized: Main menu background landscape  
[*] Added: FPS limiter option 
[*] Added: FPS limited to 30 in the Main menu 
[*] Added Steam launcher option to run the game with DirectX 11 or DirectX 12
[*] You are now able to choose DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 when launching the game on Steam. With DirectX 11, performance and stability might be improved based on your PC configuration.
